notes.title: Update 2.0 Episodes and new stuff
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23657880/ca7a713c57ed5400f1ce0c26b31a4af9a91513ca.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that the A-Gents update 2.0 is out. It brings remaining episodes, as well as some new content and features.

Highlights:
- Episodes 5 and 6
- Refined graphics and improved lighting
- Two new characters
- Five new weapons
- Two special weapons beside dynamite (sniper and air-strike)
- Several new enemies
- Animated sequences between episodes
- All achievements now unlockable

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23657880/971e50bdd2f775c0d992d7b866c568701f68da73.png[/img]

Since the game has refined graphics and features, as well as tweaked difficulty, we would encourage you to play earlier episodes again, and tell us what you think. And of course, feel free to give suggestions and point to issues if you encounter them.

Have fun,
phime studio

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23657880/0f9d72206972da8a953452998c796d4c5fbef178.png[/img]

notes.title: A-Gents - Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
1.3 EVIL PUMPKIN AND MINOR UPDATES

In the spirit of the holiday, we bring you one new achievement. 
You have to find and kill the evil pumpkin to earn it. In fact, the evil pumpkin will find you!

We listened to some suggestions, so you can turn on/off the blood now, and you can reset your progress.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.01 - 360 degree shooting
notes.notes:
We listened to your suggestions considering the movement and 4-way shooting, so we decided to introduce [b]360 degree shooting[/b], both on gamepad and [b]keyboard + mouse[/b]. Crosshairs included.

[img]http://i.giphy.com/26AHzgwdWGxZrxqX6.gif[/img]

We really hope you like it, and also expect your further suggestions. New levels are coming soon, so stay tuned.
